title: 分压器：从 9 V 得到 3 V
summary: 手上只有 9 V 电池，电路却要 3 V。两个电阻就能做到——自己搭，自己量。
description: 分压器是两个串联电阻，从中间点取出一个较低的电压：Vout = Vin × R2 / (R1 + R2)。用 9 V 电池、R1 = 2 kΩ（接 +9 V 一侧）、R2 = 1 kΩ（接 GND 一侧），让中间结点 VOUT 对 GND 约为 3 V，再用万用表验证。

cards.title: 9 V 变 3 V
text: 这一题没有步骤，**看右下角的目标电路图自己搭**。
上一课你已经搭过一个两电阻电路，它的中间点电压介于 0 和 9 V 之间。这次要把中间点**设计**成 3 V。

cards.title: 分压公式
text: 两个电阻串联，电流相同，所以**电压按电阻的比例分**：大电阻分得多，小电阻分得少。
$$V_{out} = V_{in} \times \frac{R_2}{R_1 + R_2}$$
想要 9 V 的三分之一，就让下面的 R2 占总电阻的三分之一：R1 = 2 kΩ，R2 = 1 kΩ。

cards.title: 搭好，再用万用表量
text: - **R1（2 kΩ）** 一端接 +9 V，另一端是结点 **VOUT**；**R2（1 kΩ）** 从 VOUT 接到 GND。
- 搭完点「检查我的电路」，再用万用表回答下面的题。

cards.title: 带走
text: - 分压器的输出**一接负载就会变**：负载和 R2 并联，下半截的电阻变小，VOUT 就掉下去了（第 2 世界会专门做这个实验）。
- 所以分压器适合给**几乎不取电流**的东西提供电压：比如单片机的 ADC 输入、运放的输入、一个参考电压。
- 只看比例的话，20 kΩ 和 10 kΩ 也能分出 3 V，而且更省电；代价是更“软”，更怕负载。

en.title: Voltage divider: 3 V from 9 V
en.summary: You only have a 9 V battery but the circuit wants 3 V. Two resistors do it — build it and measure it yourself.
en.description: A voltage divider is two resistors in series with a lower voltage taken from the middle: Vout = Vin × R2 / (R1 + R2). With a 9 V battery, R1 = 2 kΩ (on the +9 V side) and R2 = 1 kΩ (on the GND side), the middle node VOUT sits at about 3 V relative to GND; check it with the multimeter.
hints: Vout = Vin × R2 / (R1 + R2): for 1/3 of Vin, R2 must be 1/3 of the total resistance.
Node VOUT is the column where R1 and R2 meet; the other end of R2 goes to GND.

cards.title: 9 V into 3 V
text: This one has no steps — **build it from the target schematic** at the bottom right.
In the last lesson you built a two-resistor circuit whose middle point sat somewhere between 0 and 9 V. This time you **design** the middle point to be 3 V.

cards.title: The divider formula
text: Two resistors in series carry the same current, so **the voltage is shared in proportion to the resistances**: the bigger resistor gets more, the smaller one less.
$$V_{out} = V_{in} \times \frac{R_2}{R_1 + R_2}$$
For a third of 9 V, make the lower resistor R2 a third of the total: R1 = 2 kΩ, R2 = 1 kΩ.

cards.title: Build it, then measure it
text: - **R1 (2 kΩ)** from +9 V to the node **VOUT**; **R2 (1 kΩ)** from VOUT to GND.
- Press Check my circuit, then answer the questions below with the multimeter.

cards.title: Take away
text: - A divider's output **changes as soon as you load it**: the load sits in parallel with R2, the lower half gets smaller and VOUT drops (World 2 has a whole lab on this).
- So a divider is for things that draw **almost no current**: a microcontroller's ADC input, an op-amp input, a reference voltage.
- Only the ratio matters for the voltage: 20 kΩ and 10 kΩ also give 3 V and waste less current — at the price of being "softer", easier to pull down with a load.

measurements.ask: Red probe on the node VOUT, black probe on GND: the voltage at VOUT
measurements.explain: 9 V × 1 kΩ / (2 kΩ + 1 kΩ) = 3 V. The battery's 1.5 Ω internal resistance takes off only a few millivolts.

measurements.ask: Red probe on the +9 V end of R1, black probe (Shift + click) on VOUT: the voltage across R1
measurements.explain: R1 is twice R2, so it gets twice the voltage: 9 V × 2/3 = 6 V. The two together add up to the battery voltage.

measurements.ask: Connect another 1 kΩ "load" between VOUT and GND. VOUT will:
choices: Drop: the load is in parallel with R2, so the lower half gets smaller
measurements.explain: 1 kΩ ∥ 1 kΩ = 500 Ω, so VOUT becomes 9 × 0.5 / 2.5 = 1.8 V. A divider gives the formula value only with no load.

measurements.ask: 红表笔点结点 VOUT，黑表笔在 GND：VOUT 的电压
measurements.explain: 9 V × 1 kΩ / (2 kΩ + 1 kΩ) = 3 V。电池的 1.5 Ω 内阻只让它低几毫伏。

measurements.ask: 红表笔点 R1 接 +9 V 的那一端，黑表笔（Shift + 单击）点 VOUT：R1 两端的电压
measurements.explain: R1 是 R2 的两倍，分到的电压也是两倍：9 V × 2/3 = 6 V。两段加起来正好是电池电压。

measurements.ask: 在 VOUT 和 GND 之间再接一个 1 kΩ 的“负载”，VOUT 会？
choices: 变低：负载和 R2 并联，下半截电阻变小
measurements.explain: 1 kΩ ∥ 1 kΩ = 500 Ω，VOUT 变成 9 × 0.5 / 2.5 = 1.8 V。分压器只在空载时才是公式算的那个值。

hints: Vout = Vin × R2 / (R1 + R2)：要得到 Vin 的 1/3，R2 应该占总电阻的 1/3。
结点 VOUT 就是 R1 和 R2 相连的那一列；R2 的另一端要接到 GND。
